# Greeting recovery diagnosis

## Reproduction

Ran `& '<TRAILBUN_SOURCE>\.git\native-venv\Scripts\python.exe' -B acceptance.py`.
It exited with code 1 at acceptance.py line 3 for the first value, None.

## Cause and evidence

app/greeting.py returns `f"Hello, {name}!"`, producing `Hello, None!`
instead of `Welcome, traveler.`. It also lacks whitespace normalization
and uses the wrong greeting and punctuation.
The unchanged acceptance script covers None, empty and spaces-only names,
padded Ada, and Unicode Léa.

## Next experiment

Normalize None to `traveler`; otherwise strip surrounding whitespace and
substitute `traveler` if empty. Return `Welcome, NAME.` while preserving
case, Unicode, and the public function name. Run the exact acceptance command
and check additional whitespace and mixed-case examples. Add no dependencies.

Scope: create this diagnosis as required by HANDOFF.md and modify only
app/greeting.py. Preserve acceptance.py, HANDOFF.md, and unrelated files.
